metadata.description: Paul Cheek's personal Claude Code plugins: chief-of-staff agents for his own calendar and life admin.

plugins.name: calendar-manager
plugins.description: Agents that run Paul's calendar SOP from a Claude scheduled task: conflict scanning, commute and travel blocks, color coding, notes review and 1:1 audits. When unsure they ask in the task's chat, and each answer becomes a rule they follow from then on. A hook blocks deletes, invites (Callie on travel excepted), RSVPs and messages during runs.
